releaseNotes: Fixed a live bug in catalog/gates.ts's inferGateDomain(): it derived a validator's owning domain from the wrong path segment (index 1 of "validation/business/<slug>/<file>.ts", which is always the literal string "business", instead of index 2, the actual domain slug), so the lookup against known domain slugs always failed and silently fell through to a fallback. Every one of the 41 validation/business/ gates was misattributed as a result: 38 defaulted to domain.process and 3 (whose command name happened to contain "design") defaulted to domain.design, regardless of which domain the validator actually lived in or checked. All 41 now resolve to their real owning domain.

Added GATE_OWNER_OVERRIDES (catalog/gates.ts), a declared-owner escape hatch for gates that are genuinely cross-cutting and should not inherit whatever folder they happen to sit in. It ships empty: the three gates the 2026-08 graph-consolidation audit suspected might need it (check:provider-proof, check:asc-command-contract, check:secrets) were each re-verified by full read, and their current directory is already their correct, intentional owner. catalog/validate.ts gained two new checks so a future override can't rot silently: one flags an override naming a gate command that no longer exists, the other flags an override whose declared domain now matches the directory-derived domain anyway (nothing left for it to override).
